approval: User rejected the V1 static poster presentation, approved the external V2 convergence/fracture/dissolve video and original attack cue on 2026-11-06, then explicitly requested game integration.
source: Built-in image_gen, approved concept generated in this chat from the seven existing project portraits and late-demo-ready battlefield reference.
processing: Source image bytes retained as a portrait atlas. Native CPU meshes crop seven portraits into nine fixed radial glass panes. Independent panes converge, split into twelve textured triangles each, rotate, shrink and dissolve over 2.6 simulation seconds. Missing members retain empty glass; two extension slots bind manually designated owned non-native cards using their existing portrait sprites, retaining reserve gaps. No video playback or whole-poster fade. Follow-up user revision: cinematic duration is identical at 1x/2x; model-backed global impact feedback and actual damage labels reveal the battlefield after fracture.
display_scope: Current formation at successful order time, including undeployed members, excluding reserve-only cards. No change to damage recipients.
rights: AI-assisted derived concept based on existing Arknights character design references; preserves their original source and unconfirmed redistribution rights. User approval to integrate or upload is not rights-holder authorization.
reference_limit: Currency Wars pursuit reference BV1so1QBNEzs was inspected outside the project. V2 is the user-approved project-specific motion study, not a frame-exact recreation. The actual original fracture/all-out-attack sound is documented separately in guerrilla-original-audio.json.
